title: Letter Bee Reverse
synopsis:
After Niche carries the wounded and stunned Lag back to the Bee Hive, the Letter Bee finally begins to piece the puzzle together. Now he knows what's happened to Gauche, why the Marauders are so focused on stealing mail and the actual intent of the group controlling both, Reverse. However, when he's forbidden to reveal the truth, Lag is soon forced out of the artificial sunlight and back into the world of perpetual night. And soon Reverse's plot to take down the Letter Bees and overthrow the Amberground government begins to accelerate. If things weren't already bad enough, the giant insect creatures called gaichuu are apparently evolving into something new; there may be traitors working within the Hive; and Niche's sister, who's definitely not human friendly, shows up to turn family drama into a full-scale siege! It all spells serious trouble for the Letter Bees, but if anyone can weather the storms and gloom of night, Lag and his team are the ones who'll deliver.

(Source: FUNimation)

episodes.title: Promise
episodes.synopsis: Picking up where season one left off, the unconscious Lag is transported to the Bee Hive.

episodes.title: Underpants and Bread
episodes.synopsis: Lag and Connor search for Niche, but after a series of strange events and misunderstandings, Niche ends up rescuing Lag.

episodes.title: The Hydrangea-Colored Picture Letter
episodes.synopsis: Lag is asked to find out who sent Ray pictures of hydrangea-colored mountains. These letters remind her of her childhood and help her find strength to fight her illness.

episodes.title: Lighthouse of Illusions in the Wilderness
episodes.synopsis: Lag is seeing things...a four-eyed creature to be exact. The strange illusions continue to ensue until Lag uncovers that they are somehow based in reality.

episodes.title: Reverse World
episodes.synopsis: Many incidents are reported of Reverse Marauders attacking Bees.

episodes.title: The Little Girl Doll
episodes.synopsis: While Lag pursues a thief, Sylvette goes after Autobahn who has taken control of a carriage in order to escape.

episodes.title: Film Noir
episodes.synopsis: Lag and Niche go out of town to find Noir. While trying to stay hot on Noir's trail, Lag discovers an unusual gaichuu.

episodes.title: Blue Notes Blues
episodes.synopsis: The people of Blue Notes Blues lived in peace with the Maka until sin corrupted the hearts of man. Later, Lag discovers that Noir has entered a cave, which is a path leading to Blue Notes and the holy site.

episodes.title: 200 Years of Loneliness
episodes.synopsis: Lag and the townspeople are attacked by Niche. When Lag shoots Niche's sister, it is revealed how he met Niche and how their friendship developed.

episodes.title: Veritably Abbey
episodes.synopsis: Lag learns that spirit insects were "chosen ones," born of small insects and spirit energies. But as their hearts shed away, they become gaichuu. When that happens, they will bring peril to the land.

episodes.title: Cabernet Attacks
episodes.synopsis: The nuns head for the prayer hill, and Sunny is ordered to poison Connor. Later, Connor investigates claims against Reverse and finds Lag fighting Roda, who takes him hostage.

episodes.title: Light, Illuminating the Darkness
episodes.synopsis: When Roda continues to fight with Niche and Lag, she is floored when Lag saves her.

episodes.title: The Scarlet Red Melody
episodes.synopsis: Per a request by the government, Largo puts Zazie in charge of the personnel that will destroy the Cabernet. Later, Lag undergoes examination by Dr. Thunderland, Jr.

episodes.title: Day of Flicker
episodes.synopsis: In a Flashback, Franklin reveals the details behind the Day of Flicker.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.synopsis: Lag's request to allow Gauche to come home is denied. Largo and Dr. Thunderland seek to know how Gauche has regained his lost heart as well as what happened during his time in Akatsuki.

episodes.title: Roda, Wandering
episodes.synopsis: A flashback reveals what happened after Roda survived her fall.

episodes.title: Lies and Truth
episodes.synopsis: When capital inspectors come to interrogate Sylvette, Lag impersonates her. Meanwhile, Largo gets a tip that there are Marauders around Yuusari.

episodes.title: The Lost Heart Bullet
episodes.synopsis: There's a possibility that Noir has been using Lag's memories of Gauche as a deceptive device.  Later, Aria learns that the light from Akatsuki can cause people to lose their hearts.

episodes.title: Neither Malice, Nor Hatred
episodes.synopsis: Lag learns that, despite his intent to deliver people's hearts, it is the government who has stolen them.

episodes.title: The Smile of Hope
episodes.synopsis: Worried that the gaichuu may attack, Zazie seeks to use Connor's dingo to locate them.

episodes.title: Lawrence's Ambition
episodes.synopsis: Lag vows to defeat the Cabernet and bring back Gauche's heart. Largo leaves on a business trip, and Dr. Thunderland looks after Sunny, who is recovering at the Bee Hive.

episodes.title: A Place To Return To
episodes.synopsis: Having escaped Lawrence, Noir sets out to acquire a shindanjuu; meanwhile, Roda and the others who couldn't become spirits are taken to a dark place.

episodes.title: To Akatsuki
episodes.synopsis: Gauche has unexpectedly saved everyone from the gaichuu.

episodes.title: Final Battle! Yuusari Central
episodes.synopsis: The gaichuu are not phased by the attacks from Lag, Noir, and Zazie. Later, the Cabernet rampages through the city and the final battle ensues!

episodes.title: Light of the Heart
episodes.synopsis: Noir is severely injured. Lag uses all his strength to issue a fatal shot to the gaichuu. Later, everyone tries to continue living their lives as normally as possible.
